final: WITH by_rfi AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT b.rfistat, b.avg_modindex, b.avg_modindex - o.avg_modindex AS delta FROM by_rfi AS b CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE b.avg_modindex > o.avg_modindex), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM kept) SELECT k.rfistat, k.avg_modindex, k.delta, k.avg_modindex - m.avg_modindex AS deviation_from_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m
